parsed.summary: Tracing the drawing sheet-by-sheet, the power stage (XT60 + 10 mΩ shunt + INA219 at 0x40, MIC26903 buck with R5=6k8/R6=1k3 giving ~5 V per the stated Vout=0.8*(1+R5/R6) formula, LD39200PU33R LDO), the two MCUs (STM32H753VITx / STM32F405RGTx), the sensor set and their I2C addresses, the FCC↔NAVC UART2/I2C/GPIO link, the crystal/boot/reset circuits and all passives agree with the specification. The only apparent discrepancy — the PCA9685 strapped to 0x41 (A0 tied to +3V3) versus the spec table's '0x40' — is the electrically mandatory choice on the shared I2C2 bus (the INA219 already occupies 0x40 there), so the drawing is internally consistent and correct; the barometer RESET/EOC swap is a documented known bug, not an anomaly. No deviation supported by the drawing was found.
